notes.title: One Year Anniversary of Tavern Talk 🥳
notes.content: [h1][b]                Welcome back Innkeepers[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]           [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/f19e36c7af4ba20908d5b34808bf276269dcaa59.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We can't believe it ourselves, but [b]exactly one year ago[/b], we opened the doors to the Wayfarer's Inn and [b]released Tavern Talk[/b]! 🎉 [b]Our first entertainment game[/b] and a [b]huge step for us[/b]. Even before that, we were, and still are, so [b]grateful for all the love and support you all have given us[/b]. 💜[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the occasion, we bundled all our DLCs into one huge "[b]Dragon's Hoard Edition[/b]"-Bundle. 🐉 Containing [b]Tavern Talk[/b], [b]Tempest Tantrum[/b], the [b]Soundtrack[/b], the [b]Lorebook[/b], the [b]D&D One Shot[/b], the [b]Battle Maps[/b] and the [b]Major Arcana Tarot Cards[/b]! 🔥Best of all, for a limited time, [b]IT'S 50% OFF[/b]! 🤩 Our biggest discount yet! [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55083/Tavern_Talk_Dragons_Hoard_Edition/" style="button"]Check out the bundle right now![/url][/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget, if you already own one or more items, don't worry, because it's a "[b]complete the set[/b]" bundle. This means that you only pay for the items you do not yet own. It's the perfect way to complete your collection! 💸 And as a [b]special goodie on top[/b], we also [b]updated the Lorebook,[/b] and it now [b]includes Oleander from the Tempest Tantrum DLC[/b]. 📖 This newest addition to the bundles is the [b]15th bundle[/b] we've made![/p][p][/p][p]With that, I want to take the time to look back and give you some numbers about Tavern Talk and [b]show you all the stuff we achieved thanks to you[/b]! 👀 So many of you are forever ingrained into the game with [b]your name in the credits[/b], because of your support during [b]our two Kickstarters[/b], you brought a piece of [b]Tavern Talk into the real world[/b] with our [b]Makeship campaign and stickers[/b]. [b]So much wouldn't be possible without you[/b]. 🫶[/p][p][/p][p]Over the last year, we [b]sold almost 80.000 copies[/b] (including Nintendo Switch) 💪, you all have [b]written way over 1.400 reviews on Steam[/b] ✍️, won the [b]Gamescom Award for most wholesome 2025[/b] 🏆, and were [b]nominated for so many awards[/b]! 🥳 A couple of months after the release, we gave you the [b]story DLC Tempest Tantrum[/b], introducing a new [b]three-hour-long story[/b], a [b]new character[/b], [b]familiar[/b] and [b]drink[/b]!🍸 [/p][p][/p][p]We have had [b]16 patches on Steam[/b]. Including smaller bug fixes and improvements like sound effect implementations, ambient sounds, achievement fixes, and [b]so much more[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]Transparency and communication[/b] with our community are extremely important for us! And based on your [b]feedback & suggestions[/b] that you've left in our [url="https://discord.gg/dcRbYHWHMs"]Discord[/url], [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2076140/reviews/"]Reviews[/url], or [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2076140/discussions/"]Steam discussions[/url], we tried to implement as much as we can into Tavern Talk. ✨[/p][p][/p][p][b]Let's dive in and see how much has changed since June 20th, 2024! 👉👈[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We had many improvements for Tavern Talk, [b]ranging from big to small[/b]. Like [b]general localization improvements[/b] for our different languages. If you caught a mistake or a more fitting phrasing in our game for your native language, we implemented this change as fast as we could, after consulting with our localization teams. They edited the [b]English[/b] version to raise quality and translated Tavern Talk into [b]Japanese[/b], [b]Simplified Chinese,[/b] [b]Korean, [/b]and[b] German [/b](yes, we didn't have the capacity and time to do that ourselves). [/p][p][/p][p]We learned that sometimes less is more, and so we [b]changed the frequency[/b] of the [b]Swift Strike[/b] that was ordered a lot in the beginning. So much so that [b]it even became a meme[/b]. 😅 [/p][p][/p][p]      [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/49f624b5e59e8d189f1f9a3f2f4c896d8af2539f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Another meme became the pooping bird in the background and while it still poops, it happens way less often now. 🐦‍⬛ [b]That evil, evil bird[/b]...[/p][p][/p][p]For all the Streamers and Content Creators, we ensured that the game sound was still running in the background even if you tapped out of the game. That way, [b]you can still enjoy the cozy tavern music[/b]! 🎶 [b]This is not the only thing we implemented for Streamers[/b], but more on that later when we [b]take a look at the features[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]One of the first big changes[/b] we made was implementing a [b]more challenging rumor minigame[/b] and the [b]hint button[/b] for everybody who needs the extra bit of help. ⭐[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/a162ff15fa515536e67876e4816c42cd6b65df1b.png"][/img][/p][p]Over time, we added new [b]Wanted Wall characters[/b] thanks to our [b]original Kickstarter[/b] and our [b]second Kickstarter[/b], all about the official sticker set! 📜[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/db7f3dcc7bd07343017198a734c72412af3e9d6a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We implemented more [b]monitor-dependent resolutions[/b] and [b]added a monitor selection option in the settings menu[/b]. For anyone who has more than one monitor with different resolutions. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/a1193a8c9e5510a6bf52beeb57412c03a7fd99af.png"][/img][/p][p]And we even got [b]decorations for anybody with a wide-screen monitor[/b]! I mean, who wants to see black bars on their [b]beautiful, wide monitor[/b], am I right? 🖥️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/720a64ba47541e828e325fefe60d03b810ac9ba4.png"][/img][/p][p]Hot chocolate is Melina's favorite drink, and for some odd reason, in the days after release, she thought [b]every drink was hot chocolate[/b]. Can't really blame her for that wishful thinking, right? Now she detects the hot chocolate just when she actually gets one. 🍫[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/99c901ad72f6e7fc12ad4623628b9fd5e1219040.png"][/img][/p][p]Last but not least on the list of improvements - [b]the Steam Deck[/b]! Tavern Talk was not only our first entertainment game, but also the [b]first game we developed for the Steam Deck and Nintendo Switch[/b]! [/p][p]And while the UI was [b]perfectly fine for your PC or TV[/b], it [b]wasn't quite enough for a smaller handheld device[/b]. Something we changed very swiftly to make it through [b]Steam Deck verification[/b]! ✅[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/970c10934c38361ac9183aea043d6e231e9216a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Let's move on to all the beautiful...[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We originally gave the [b]alternative Fable Costume[/b] to all [b]Kickstarter Supporters [/b]backing a copy of the game[b]. [/b]Today, everybody owning the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268390/Tavern_Talk_Supporter_Edition_Upgrade/"]Supporter Edition Upgrade[/url] gains access to it! 🥰 This is one of our first features for the game, and the design was part of a vote on our Discord! [b]It's completely community-powered[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/d152fa74cf13bb5ccee336b0030b7837768848ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As mentioned before, we had [b]something special[/b] planned for our [b]dearest Streamers,[/b] and that was our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2076140/announcements/detail/4480612432780198283"]Twitch integration[/url]! Enabling your chat to participate in your Tavern Talk streaming sessions in a more meaningful way! 🔴[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/18fbada37ac70a91c543d803c97917f4767f6e5e.png"][/img][/p][p]Through [b]certain commands[/b], participants can vote on dialogue choices and drinks, and even pet Andu whenever you spend time in the drink mixing nook![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/67e85bf43d40bb919dceed2c4f2efd1aea95f997.png"][/img][/p][p]The other feature we can no longer live without is the [b]Fast-Forward button[/b]! With multiple endings, it soon became very clear that we needed to find a way to let you run through the game faster. 🛣️[/p][p][/p][p]And thanks to the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2076140/announcements/detail/4354503396515435903"]Fast-Forward button on screen and the "remember dialogue"[/url] button in the settings, you can go through a second, third, and fourth run [b]at the speed of light[/b]! 💫[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/293fbe07385f3bfd1dfc164870c73804dea896e1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And one of our latest features is the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2076140/announcements/detail/545601771364420606"]Trinket Gallery and Zoom[/url]! The trinkets mean a lot to the story of Tavern Talk, but also to us because some of them are [b]co-designed by our Kickstarter backers[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]So giving them even [b]more of a spotlight besides the lorebook[/b] and in-game appearance was something we anticipated for a long time, and eventually delivered this spring. 😻[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/c47b5747cfe7603c8350b3b280e9f9df8efaff13.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The in-game zoom[/b] that the game now does every time you receive a trinket makes it extra special and fits into the game so well! This was also a suggestion made by the community. 💜[/p][p][/p][p]                                    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/b2f9a36f544e1c103448226ce6f8b24fe4f07937.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]One more section to go! 🤩[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Events[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Just like us, Tavern Talk and the world of Asteria are constantly changing, and things are just happening. And to symbolize this, we decided to implement seasonal events! For example, the [b]Fall season[/b]. 🎃[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/47b06163b799fa09e27e2f61975fb4aae3e304bb.png"][/img][/p][p]The cozy and freezing cold [b]Winter season[/b]. ❄️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/3233cbb6b99686bb940b73bcb7b06f9854d9f0dc.png"][/img][/p][p]And right now, we have the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2076140/announcements/detail/532099213295617820"]Among Us crew running around causing chaos[/url]. This special seasonal event even comes with [b]its own Twitch commands[/b]. 👀[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/fcfb06dec179a87f7a924267f6f13925d1d06686.png"][/img][/p][p]Even if you are [b]not in the mood for a specific season,[/b] we have you covered! We implemented a button in the main menu settings where you can turn the season [b]on and off, however you like[/b]. 🫰[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/bae30f368cd3e69a77a9958461dc3e627cef367d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We learned a lot implementing all of these changes and plan to bring them all to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3500880/Tavern_Talk_Stories_Dreamwalker/"]Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker[/url] as well![/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of which, if you want to be among the first to [b]play the demo of Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker[/b] when it drops, [url="https://playtaverntalk.com/?origin=ttsteam"]sign up for our newsletter[/url]. Stay informed and grab some [b]slick mobile phone wallpapers as a free gift[/b] as you go. 👀 [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://playtaverntalk.com/?origin=ttsteam" style="button"]Sign up now[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/da4e9358dfcbe94b192e47d3f6eeb2b8bc21721c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That was quite a lot. I hope you all enjoyed this retrospective on Tavern Talk! Thank you for everything! [/p][p]Until then, stay safe 💜 Tommy[/p]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/205677ffdade7c1d2ca5914602ec49db38077aca.png[/img]

[h1][b]Dear Innkeepers,[/b][/h1]

We're super hyped to share that we've been quietly working on a collaboration together with the beautiful people at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Innersloth/][b]Innersloth[/b][/url]. 🥰 Today, we're proud to bring the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/945360/Among_Us/][b]Among Us crew[/b][/url] to our little tavern in Asteria in an exciting [b]seasonal free content update[/b]! 🔥

Until the end of June, the [b]tiny space crew will wreak havoc in the Wayfarer's Inn[/b]. 
Some screens and events will look differently - for example, [b]the bell used to complete drink mixing[/b] will be replaced with [b]the emergency button[/b] sending not only magical drinks through the primordial vortex, but maybe even an imposter or two. 👀

[previewyoutube=PRZUECV47NA;full][/previewyoutube]

And there is more: To celebrate this update, we have put a heavy discount in place for Tavern Talk, its DLCs, and our bundles! 

[h3][b]Twitch commands are here![/b][/h3]
If you're a [b]streamer or content creator[/b], there is more to get excited about: we have implemented [b]Twitch commands[/b], which your viewers can use in-chat. (If you need a quick reminder of how the Twitch integration works, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2076140/view/4480612432780198282?l=english][b]read here[/b][/url]!)

Once your account is connected, [b]anyone in your chat[/b] can type in the command [b]"!ttghost"[/b] to make an Among Us ghost appear under the counter, who will spook a crew member. 

[previewyoutube=y2WqAUWK7BA;full][/previewyoutube]

The other command is [b]"!tthunt"[/b]. A whole Among Us crew will pop up and start chasing each other over the screen.

[previewyoutube=UpyJu0JCNnc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Turn seasonal events off in the settings[/b][/h3]

Not interested in any of this? No problem! If you are not in the mood for the Among Us shenanigans or any other seasonal event, there is now an option in the settings menu to turn them off entirely so you can enjoy the pure original Tavern Talk immersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/bae30f368cd3e69a77a9958461dc3e627cef367d.png[/img]

Seasonal events will happen throughout the year, but you can decide if you want to have them in your game.

Are you excited for our next outer-dimensional collab? The Among Us event starts right now and is available with the update dropped today!

[h2][b]Heavy discounts 💯[/b][/h2]

To celebrate this collaboration, we have discounted Tavern Talk by 30%! [b]Our highest discount, yet, and we didn't stop there[/b]!

For the first time, our story [b]DLC Tempest Tantrum[/b] has a [b]20% discount[/b], and the [b] Supporter Upgrade[/b] got its first discount as well.[b] It's 30% off[/b] as are the [b]Lorebook[/b], [b]OST[/b],[b] P&P One Shot[/b], [b]Battlemaps[/b], and [b]Major Arcana Tarot Set[/b].

So if you were looking at the bundles or just a DLC for you or a friend, now is the time! 🔥

And we are still not finished! [b]In two days, we'll have another huge announcement for ya'll![/b] 👀 If you want to be one of the first ones to get all the latest updates, giveaways & other special events, make sure to [url=playTavernTalk.com][b]sign up for our newsletter.[/b][/url] ⤵️

[url=playTavernTalk.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/98f437f58c352f7c2cb0d255eba95a30e752c1e6.png[/img][/url]


Cheers,
Tommy

notes.title: Introducing: The ANDU RETRO COLLECTION! 💜
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hey Innkeepers 👀[/h1][/b]

we have some amazing news for y'all! 🎉 It's no secret that everybody loves Andu. 💜 So we made it to our sole mission to give you as much Andu as possible. 

[b]Presenting[/b] - [b]THE ANDU RETRO COLLECTION[/b] 🔥

For the nostalgic feeling we all crave we put Andu (and other familiars) in the retro games of your childhood. 🕹️

Starting off with [b]Pong[/b] or as we like to call it - [b]Andong[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/97da9d69d2581a3368b0e0893b5998b40a619176.jpg[/img]

Play as [b]Andu against Renu[/b] in this thrilling match of Pong. [b]Single-player only[/b] - to keep the Tavern Talk spirit alive. 🎉

Next up, do you have what it takes to stack Andu to the top? [b]Hopefully not[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/bf59c987e96f2ba6d6901ed94d5e5d8ff22ddb72.jpg[/img]

Tetris meets Andu to give you [b]Andris[/b]. In this puzzle game, you need to think fast before all the Andus fall to the floor and stack upon each other! But be careful, once they reach the top, the game is over! 😮

Oh oh, is this an invasion of magical drinks?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/b80f544da5a7fb7a77bc45d6527826ebdd4ef7f3.jpg[/img]

Space Invaders, but it's magical drinks instead of aliens in [b]Andu Invader[/b]! Blast the drinks away, so the patrons get none and Andu can have them all! 👾

Speaking of giving Andu all the drinks... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/ef8b321df10b909f2ac0e1696a88f8881429be7f.jpg[/img]

Forget Pac Man, [b]it's ANDU MAN[/b]! Eat all the magical drinks and treats, but better be fast - Skully is haunting you and maybe some other patrons will try to stop you! 🍹

Remember this next gem?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/ff0656122cb2bcbef47c76db620b7d8bc8d9252c.jpg[/img]

Flappy bird was yesterday, [b]FLAPPY ANDU is now[/b]! And it comes with a day one DLC if you want to play as Flappy Dindi (only 9.99$!) 💸

Last but not least...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/4e3acbfcde9f5c7c4bd16d467ffd3bfc2241b456.jpg[/img]

Ever wanted your own desktop familiar to feed and care for? Well, now you can with [b]ANDUGOTCHI[/b]! Andu will sit right by your side, you can feed him desktop trash, magical drinks and other cute stuff. The best thing is - Andu needs only to be fed every two minutes. So he won't be distracting or anything. 🥰

What happens if you don't feed him? You don't wanna know. Haha.

But we saved the best information until the end. You're probably wondering - How much is this gonna cost me? 1 Million bucks??? 😱

No silly, for the low, low price of [b]119,59$[/b] this collection of hastily put-together games can be yours! That is [b]less than 20 bucks per game[/b]. You are actually robbing us! 🫰

What are you waiting for? ⏰

[u][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_Fools%27_Day][h1][b]Get your Andu Retro Collection now!!![/b][/h1][/url]
[/u]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ][u][h1][b]Listen to the official Andu Retro Collection soundtrack on Spotify![/b][/h1][/u][/url]

Cheers,
Tommy

notes.title: Free Content Update For Base Game & Supporter Edition! 💯
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Innkeepers![/b][/h1]

We've been listening to your wishes and now they're here – the new trinket features! 🤝 One of the most highly requested and anticipated features was [b]giving the trinkets more attention[/b] when receiving them. It's amazing that you all enjoyed them so much that you wanted a closer look. 👀

We've thought about it for a while and decided to do this in [b]two different ways[/b]. Firstly, when the patrons gift their trinkets to the innkeeper we are [b]zooming in on them to celebrate the moment[/b]. This will also give you a good sense of what changed in your tavern. ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/186a72b57a30043a7e73dd07cd3a40a0a0dca430.gif[/img]

Secondly, we've added [b]a gallery[/b] where you can [b]marvel at all the trinkets you've collected[/b] throughout the game. Moreover, every trinket comes with a note about which quest you obtained it from. 📜

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/f741427094e411ab65afe19b87ebf06f6e8fb0cc.jpg[/img]

We hope these additions [b]cater to your collector's soul[/b]! Do you know what's best about it? You won't have to play through the game again. Any [b]trinkets held in your save file will automatically appear in the gallery[/b] so head over there and browse through your collection of legendary and mysterious gifts of your patrons. And maybe you want to start filling in the blanks – the gallery will tell you which trinkets are still waiting for you to find them. 😶‍🌫️

Already feeling the itch to set out and explore other branches of the plot? Trust us, this is where the Fast-Forward button will come in real handy. [url=https://youtu.be/bQwJ9EPzV8Y][b]Here is how you activate it[/b][/url]. 

If you need any visual help on how the new trinket feature is implemented into the game, [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/unLAw1xU4h4][b]here is a little video I made for you[/b][/url]! 

[b][h1]MOAR Content for the Supporter Upgrade 💪[/h1][/b]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268390/Tavern_Talk_Supporter_Edition_Upgrade][b]Supporter Edition Upgrade[/b][/url] has been of our DLC catalog since October. It's a great way to offer our supportive community some extra spice. 🔥 And since you all supported us so incredibly through your reviews, discussion topics, and being active on our [url=https://discord.gg/dcRbYHWHMs][b]Discord[/b][/url], we wanted to [b]give something back[/b] and decided to [b]stack up the content in this special DLC[/b]! 💯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/6b2ed8efdb393ebad7a635c19461ff4077bed5eb.png[/img]

From today on the Supporter Edition Upgrade DLC now contains 10 wallpapers for your desktop and mobile device (that's an [b]additional eight wallpapers[/b]), a [b]digital map of Asteria[/b], and [b]instructions to unlock the secret alternative costume for Fable[/b]!

Here's a shot of what it looks like: 💃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/d152fa74cf13bb5ccee336b0030b7837768848ac.jpg[/img]

If you already own the Supporter Edition Upgrade [b]we'd love to say thank you[/b] for making that extra stretch to support us as an indie studio! We highly appreciate it. 💜

The content of your DLC should update automatically and make all of the above directly available. If you have trouble accessing anything, please reach out to us in the community discussions! 💪

[h1][b]Roadmap Update 📍[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/8db7dd7427b7f0bf6a532a49b0115242c6fde73d.png[/img]

Since we started out on this journey [b]our little tavern game has constantly grown and improved[/b]. Today, we are checking off the last item on our roadmap for now, but we are [b]far from finished[/b]. Thanks to the suggestions & feedback from your reviews and discussions we're discussing how we can create even more enthralling experiences with the [b]new games we're already working on[/b] (expect a [b]major announcement to drop in Q2 2025[/b] and [url=https://taverntalkgame.com/][b]sign up to our newsletter[/b][/url] to stay in the full loop) so keep the suggestions coming! 🥰

Lastly, we may or may not have another update for this game in the works we're super eggcited about so keep your eyes peeled! 🥚 👀

Stay tuned, and as always please consider [b]leaving a review[/b]! It helps us make more wonderful games like Tavern Talk.

[h1][b]Tavern Talk is in a big discount now with 20% 🪧[/b][/h1]

We are part of the upcoming [b]Visual Novel Fest[/b] & [b]Women's Day Sale[/b] on Steam! 💫 And to celebrate our participation [b]we discounted Tavern Talk by 20%,[/b] yet again. So, if you're still considering gifting it to yourself or a friend now is a good time! ⏰ 

Maybe even in a package deal like our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46955/Tavern_Talk_Pen__Paper_Edition/][b]"Pen & Paper"-Bundle[/b][/url], that we brought back for all the TTRPG fans. 💜 Since we have discounts on most of our DLCs as well, [b]the bundles are getting even juicier[/b], giving you more bang for your buck.🫰

You can discover many other amazing games during [b]Visual Novel Fest [/b] & [b]Women's Day Sale[/b], so keep an eye out. 👁️

See you there and until then,
Tommy 😊

notes.title: Gentle Troll wishes you a happy 2025 🥳 + Presenting fan art contest winners!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello dear Innkeepers,[/b][/h1]

2024 will always be a special year for us and sometimes it's great to celebrate your achievements. It's the year when we debut [b]our first entertainment game[/b] and all of you[b] took it in with open arms[/b], thank you so much for that. 💜 It's the year we[b] fulfilled our first Kickstarter[/b], started and [b]finished our second Kickstarter[/b], released our [b]story DLC[/b], won "[b]Most Wholesome[/b]" at Gamescom, reached over [b]1000 Reviews on Steam[/b], gained over [b]10000 followers[/b] for Tavern Talk on Steam and almost [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44635803][b]1000 for our Studio page[/b][/url]!

This community made this whole experience beautiful and one-of-a-kind. 🥰 And a couple of months ago we had a little fan art contest over on [url=https://x.com/GentleTrollDevs][b]Twitter[/b][/url] to celebrate the release of the game on Nintendo Switch for Japan and Korea! We got 6 winners in the end and want to show you their incredible art right now. 🎨

[h2]Fan art contest winners[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/1cdd06cf1fca4a01a3a3ef7f2823a22510d697a3.jpg[/img]

First up, we have this beautiful Anime rendition from [url=https://x.com/sonizasx/status/1846078507191042320][b]SONI[/b][/url]. 👀 That definitely let us dream of our own Anime adaption for Tavern Talk 💫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/0713797beff959a0a77b30ab2d92368ca4f6140d.jpg[/img]

Next up is [url=https://x.com/umaiicetabe2/status/1854724404112249139][b]ASOBI[/b][/url] who gave two amazing artworks, but we'll always be a sucker for Eleithyia. 👑

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/9b38bf199e689a7c7d7905f8f53d404a738ac36f.jpg[/img]

I mean, having Rogue with their familiar always hits a sweet spot.👉👈 It's soooo cute! Thanks to [url=https://x.com/ram1waru/status/1849716535432184267][b]外町ゆらこ[/b][/url] we have this somber and wholesome moment. 🐑🐟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/47c19223b9947bb56fdc341585abd9bb8894f26a.jpg[/img]

Let's hear it for Grace and this amazingly cute image of her by [url=https://ko-fi.com/trirogue95][b]TriRogue95[/b][/url]. 🪄 Truly magical!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/0b60eb465e9e5126da310d8a5806a1284c724d3c.jpg[/img]

Ever thought about pixel Fable? Well, now you do and it's all thanks to [b]hachihun[/b]! 💚 Aren't they just so retro-chic now? 👏

[previewyoutube=UFxENhIkttk;full][/previewyoutube]

And our last winner had a[b] full-blown video for us[/b]! Thank you so much [url=https://www.instagram.com/maroisedot/][b]Maroisedot[/b][/url] for this and now everybody has this song stuck inside their head. 🥰

We need to thank each and everyone who put all their efforts into this contest and gave us such incredible artwork! Each winner will receive a complete Tavern Talk sticker set in early 2025 and we can't wait to do more events like these in the near future!

[h1][b]Heading out and celebrating with you! [/b]🎆[/h1]

We will continue our journey with all of you in 2025! And while the road ahead may seem uncertain with everything that is going on in the world right now, we know that we [b]can face everything together as a community[/b]. Tavern Talk is a game [b]about defying the odds[/b], [b]found family[/b] and [b]rising above everything together[/b]. 

In 2025 we'll come back with new projects and updates. We can't wait to show you everything we have in store for you. 🎮

Again, thank you for everything! You all are the reason, that we can do what we love. 💜

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/94904c4b81a86018b6bf0eb324b667f92e99fe51.jpg[/img]

Cheers,
your Gentle Trolls

notes.title: 🟣 Play with your community - Twitch Integration is here! 🟣
notes.content:
[h1][b] Tavern Talk is getting cozier 💜[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/4a718e0794eeb2d1a8b9d8a6cb35cfbddd8b3482.png[/img]

[b]Dear Innkeepers[/b],

With our newest feature to the game you can bring your community into the Wayfarer's Inn! - [b]Introducing Twitch Integration[/b]. We love how creative and wholesome content creators all over the world are! Seeing them and their community gave us the idea - [b]let's have the chat decide what comes next[/b].

The Twitch integration is [b]only supported on Mac and Windows[/b], not on Steam Deck. Since it is the first time we've implemented a feature like this we all hope you'll be patient with the process, if something doesn't work right away or needs to be changed.

But how does it work? We have a step-by-step instruction for you, but also if you need a more visual guide, here you go: 

[previewyoutube=CLOXz4Tc24c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]How to use the Twitch Integration[/b][/h2]

[olist]
[*] Go into your in-game settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/970fb52082aa57c69b80580a6881e351e908afeb.jpg[/img]

[*] The tab on the far right shows a Twitch-Icon open it & click Authenticate. This will open a webpage, first asking you to enter a device code. This code should already be set.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/0994d1b260dab8ff34e9c26418446b42ebbae740.png[/img]

[*] After that you should be redirected to a page where you authorize the application to use your account to read the Twitch chat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/15318668ede622016d47c8e71b124c7848c4b3ed.png[/img]

[*] Back in the game settings you should be authenticated and the user and channel name should be filled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/6b63e0f55eb8964a74a93b6184ecbb91f1c53160.jpg[/img]

[*] User and channel names should be right in most cases, but if not you can edit them. In most cases both user name and channel name should be the same.

[*] The last thing is to connect with Twitch chat by pressing the connect button. [b]This last step needs to be repeated everytime you launch Tavern Talk![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/919ea865b8923bb9f5f61278faee2248a18b96d2.jpg[/img]
[/olist]

[*] Now [b]your community can vote[/b] whenever you have to make a decision or a quest drink. You just have to press the play button and each viewer gets one vote on the option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/b69dbce5d3d73b7540af1b497a53742d513cd3b2.jpg[/img]

[h3]What viewers can do:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Vote on specific dialog answers by writing 1, 2 or 3 in the chat 🗨️
[*] Vote on quest drinks by writing 1 or 2 in the chat 🍸
[*] Pet Andu via the command [b]!pet andu[/b] 🥰
[/list]

And that's all of it! We can't wait to see more streams and the funny situations that are coming with it!

We also have some bug fixes for you!

[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Quest creation breaks when switching between mouse & controller
[*] Visual and Audio fixes
[*] You can access the Sticker Kickstarter out of the load game screen with a controller
[*] Drink Mixing Infusion Outlines stay in place when playing with a controller
[/list]

[h1]What is coming next[/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3244740/Tavern_Talk_Tempest_Tantrum/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/19d0f8f627e5575caf43ec884305a33c5012f29d.jpg[/img][/url]

Our [b]Story DLC: Tempest Tantrum[/b] is coming closer and closer! Mark the date in your calender - [b]November 12th[/b]!

But that's not all! Currently, we have our Sticker Collection Kickstarter running and we already made 500% over the goal! 💯If you want to grab some high-quality stickers and the first Tavern Talk Merch, then this is your chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/7fa2fbb7e4e87b8609d460852f672f178a8838a8.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gentletroll/tavern-talk-the-official-sticker-collection?ref=user_menu][h3]Click here to check it out![/h3][/url]

More news to share soon!

Cheers,

notes.title: Gotta go fast! - There is now a Fast-Forward button & less Swift Strike! 🏃‍♂️💨
notes.content:
[h1][b]The day has come! The Fast-Forward button is in the game![/b][/h1]

[b]Dear Innkeepers[/b],

did you know Tavern Talk has [b]three different endings[/b] and [b]one additional secret ending[/b]? No? While we have read a few comments reflecting that choices don't seem to matter, they actually do. Especially in the long run over the entirety of the four acts – it may not be as noticeable in the first hours of the game. But trust, us, [b]the drinks you brew and how you treat your patrons leave a mark on the path you take through Tavern Talk[/b]. 

Tavern Talk takes between [b]12 and 20 hours to complete a single run[/b], so, now that you know, you may be wondering how you're supposed to see all of these endings without rereading each and every dialog bubble on every run. Well, some of you actually went all the way to do just that and we're mightily impressed by your effort! [b]WOW![/b] 😲 For those who couldn't bring themselves to do so, we have the [b]bestest of news[/b]: 

[b][h1]Fast-Forward button to the rescue![/h1][/b]

This patch brings a new button to your in-game UI [b]you need to activate in the settings[/b]: the [b]Fast-Forward button[/b] (see screenshot below). This button will have you jump super fast through dialog bubbles and halt at the next decision or drink-mixing for you to make.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/dd75ea2d8266eb18b602f8680d8fd7d72c6368c4.png[/img]

Again, please note that you need [b]to activate the button in the settings in order to use this feature[/b]. We chose to do this since this feature doesn't make sense for people new to the game and we didn't want to clog the UI.

This feature alone should give you a big hand plowing through the content at the speed of light. But it gets even better:

[h2][b]Fast-Forward known dialog bubbles only![/b][/h2]

While the game has no way of skipping bubbles you've read before this patch, because the game didn't track them, yet, it now [b]starts tracking and offers an option to skip tracked dialog in future runs[/b]. This means that once you decide to rerun a certain section no matter which savegame you're playing you can activate the "Only skip read dialogs" checkbox in the settings (see screenshot below) to have the game speed run bubbles you know but go slow on the one's you haven't seen yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/8807883437993b8cb1375d0fd1705bc758e7bd39.png[/img]

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE[/b]: if you're a Tavern Talk veteran and want to see the other endings, skipping known dialog won't work, yet, because tracking starts only now. Please go to the settings to activate the Fast-Forward button and make sure "Only skip read dialogs" is turned [b]OFF[/b]! Since there is no tracked dialog to skip, yet, [b]it would seem to you the Fast-Forward feature is broken, while it's not[/b]. You need to [b]feed the tracker first by manually using the Fast-Forward feature for sections you already know.[/b] Once you have [b]completed your first run[/b], you can [b]turn on the "Only skip read dialog" feature to make your life easier[/b] because it will then have data to work with. We understand it's not entirely convenient, but it was the only approach we could have implemented this feature post-release.

If you need a bit of help, here is a video tutorial for you: 

[previewyoutube=bQwJ9EPzV8Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you appreciate the new Fast-Forward features and they will bring you joy in sunny breezing through the entirety of the Tavern Talk story without missing an outcome or dialog unknown to you. 💯

You can keep track of your previous playthroughs yourself or use the "100% Achievements Guide"-guide Magi752 has kindly provided here on Steam: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3274505211]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3274505211[/url]

That way you know exactly which dialog road you haven't traveled down, yet, which drink you need to make next, or which dialogue option you haven't chosen before.

Happy reruns, everyone! 💝 

[b][h1]Farewell Swift Strike mania! 👋[/h1][/b]

It became a [b]meme in our community[/b], that there were [b]too many Swift Strike orders[/b] in the game and it became obvious we had to change that. [b]And now we have[/b]! 🍹

While Swift Strike will remain Fable's favorite drink (we couldn't convince them otherwise) this patch introduces more varied drink requests at the Wayfarer's Inn and the game should not feel as repetitive anymore. 🎮  We had to rework some of the dialog for this, mainly because Swift Strike is the only dexterity-based drink in the early game and that remains a bit of a problem and isn't easily fixed.

So now, characters often ask for alternative drinks. Jade, for example, will now order an intelligence-based drink rather than a dexterity one and Fable wants to try out something new from time to time. 💚

Thanks to everyone hinting to this issue and that the game could use a little variety here and there so we could go and investigate. Some things simply get overlooked with development blinders stuck to our heads. 🫶

So let's order it one last time, shall we? A Swift Strike to go, please! 🍸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/49f624b5e59e8d189f1f9a3f2f4c896d8af2539f.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]More secrets in the game 😲[/h1][/b]

Thanks to the amazing support on Kickstarter, we were able to [b]implement a secret[/b] into the game and it has something to do with this Fable sticker on the main title screen. 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/8597ec307b62edca58fa0d07f45d420b99c73fdc.png[/img]

[b]Can you guess what it is[/b]? Let us know in the comments! 💜 

[h1][b]Roadmap update[/b][/h1]

We planned those changes a bit later in August, but made haste and finished them earlier than expected, thanks to our amazing team! We still have some improvements for the end of the year, so let us share the [b]current state of the roadmap[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/8dac01139da215f0ce43fbf967b99df70aea34d2.png[/img]

As this journey continues, we  want to grow with all of you and make the Wayfarer's Inn cozier and better with each update. So thank you for sharing your improvement suggestions in the Steam Community Hub and our Discord server. ✨ This way we can engage easily, ask questions, offer transparent info on why we made certain decisions, or find solutions for reoccurring requests. We love to make Tavern Talk a better experience for you to enjoy and while we cannot implement each and every request out there we're always sensitive to things that come up frequently and align with our creative vision for the game. 

[h1][b]A 10% discount is up![/b][/h1]

Last but not least: we are running our first discount after launch. The game and all DLC are discounted by 10% for Wholesome Sale and if you are in for a very special deal, make sure to check out the [b]Innkeeper Bundle[/b] featuring a nice package of the game, Lorebook, and the wonderful OST for an [b]even better deal[/b]. So, if you were waiting for a good chance to grab Tavern Talk, for yourself or to gift it to a friend, now is a good time! So grab the discount while it's up! 🤩

[b]Keep the suggestions comingand please consider leaving a review[/b]!

Until next time, 
Michel & Tommy

notes.title: Bye bye color coding - Hello there hint-on-demand-button! 👀
notes.content:
Dear Innkeepers,

we're back with exciting news: we're putting the puzzle back into the rumor mini-game! 

[b][h1]We have heard your calls... [/h1][/b]

... and with today's patch, rumor snippets that belong together will no longer look alike - except for random accidents, of course. We understand that the rumor mini-game as it shipped on release may have [b]felt overly easy and unchallenging[/b] while the original [b]demo suggested a more puzzly approach[/b]. So we made haste to find a suitable solution for all of you: to [b]those who love themselves a good challenge[/b] and to [b]those who just want to breeze through the story[/b] or [b]who find the sheer amount of snippets in the later parts of the game overwhelming[/b].

For those who want it easy, we have now added a new [b]"hint-on-demand"-button[/b] that will appear should you fail putting together a quest for the first time. It is then up to you to use that button to ask the game for a hint about which snippets belong together. If you do, it will highlight all of the relevant snippets for the current round of quest-making. If several quests need to be found, the game won't tell you which snippets belong together, but since it will allow you to focus on a clear sub-set of rumors we are sure you will manage. 

If you belong to the first group and prefer to rack your brain given no clues at all simply ignore that button and go for it! This is what it now looks like in the game: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/a162ff15fa515536e67876e4816c42cd6b65df1b.png[/img]

[b]We're quite happy with the solution[/b] we found here and we hope you feel the same. May it let you all enjoy the game even more! We will update the demo with this big adjustment, as well, so it also shows the updated gameplay.

Now, let's have a look at the [b]other improvements[/b] and fixes this patch brings with it:

[b][h1]Improvements & Bug fixes[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Expose monitor-dependent resolutions and add a monitor selection option[/b]:  You can now select the resolutions fitting to your monitor. Do you have a 4k screen? No Problem. Or maybe a widescreen? We've got you covered! Even if you have a second screen plugged into your machine, you can now choose which screen the game should be displayed on. If you should encounter any issues with this, please get in touch through the support link on our Steam page. 🖥️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/e452696b07ce4354decc1b4a66bdf1723dd26742.png[/img]

[*] [b]Added some SFXs missing for controller inputs[/b] ... to give you an even more immersive experience.  🎮
[*] [b]Added new names to the guestbook entries & updated names for the Credits Kickstarter backer[/b]: Some names in the credits and in the guestbook entries were still missing. Digging in we found there was quite a hiccup in our export. Sorry for that! We're confident we finally fixed it for good. All backers who wanted to be named should appear in the credits now.  ✅
[*] [b]Fixed typos in German[/b]: Thanks to your keen eyes we found more typos in the German translation. It's a bit ironic since we're a studio from Germany, we know. We should have done more aufpassen in the Schule back in the day! We cleaned everything up and it should be a way smoother read now. Dangefön! 🫶
[*] [b]Melina now detects HOT CHOCOLATE just when she actually gets one[/b]: Hot chocolate is Melina's favorite drink and for some reason, she thought every drink was hot chocolate. Can't really blame her for that wishful thinking, right? 🍫
[*] [b]Fixed some pronoun issues[/b]: Some pronoun variables got mixed up, so we fixed them! 😊
[/list]

[b][h1]Glimpse into the (near) future[/h1][/b]

That's a wrap concerning today's patch! But we have more changes lined up for the near future and on the remote horizon so we decided to give you a tiny roadmap for what's coming up:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/bcd57225a3d0fb9e57f7f6acc5e67d953773c691.png[/img]

As always, thank you for  your feedback and suggestions through the reviews and the discussions on  the Community Hub and of course in our Discord! We love to look for ways to improve our debut game based on your feedback as we continue to grow as a studio and as a community. Thank you for your engagement and for being a part of this journey! 💜

[b]Keep the suggestions coming[/b]!

Until next time, 
Tommy

notes.title: Thanks to your feedback, we are making Tavern Talk even better! 💪
notes.content:
[h1]Our Community is growing and feedback has been amazing 🤩[/h1]

Hey there Innkeepers,

First of all we want to thank you all from the bottom of our collected hearts! As of this moment, we have over [b]566 reviews[/b], this is simply incredible. Thank you all for taking the time and leaving your thoughts behind, helping us to make Tavern Talk even better. 💜

With this announcement, we want to show you, that we are listening to your suggestions and trying to implement them into the game to the best of our abilities. Thanks to your reviews and discussions in the Community Hub we already got some amazing insight, that we were able to patch in. One infamous bug in the game that scrabbled up the pronouns of the Innkeeper is already fixed for example. 🐞

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/de31a00b163059983a106f3f7b159cf60c6cb658.jpg[/img]

But that's not all... 👀

[h2]🚨 What is coming next? 🚨[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]The Auto-Skip button[/b]: Since we have multiple endings in the game (3 endings and 1 hidden one) we are aware that replayability is important and you showed us how important it is for you as well. Right now we are figuring out how to implement a super-fast autoplay button, letting you (sunny) breeze through the game without any issues. That way you can take a different path and try different dialogue options. 💯

[*] [b]Making the rumor-minigame more challenging[/b]: During our QA sessions, we saw an issue with how hard the rumor-minigame can be in Act 2 and forward, and decided to make it easier by color-coding the rumor-snippets, so nobody gets soft-locked during their playthrough. But the feedback showed us, that a little bit of challenge was actually welcomed in our cozy visual novel. That is why we are looking into inserting the randomized colors for the rumor-snippets back into the game and making the easier path optional, just in case somebody needs the extra help. 🫶

[*] [b]Trinkets[/b]: We are so happy that you enjoy the trinkets that the adventurers bring back from their quests and that you want to get a better look at them. And to make a space to honor them the right way, they will not only appear in your tavern but also in a dedicated page in your journal! 📖

[*] [b]SFX and screen improvements[/b]: Something we will always strive for is to make Tavern Talk as good-looking and sounding as possible! That way, no matter where you play the game, on your TV-screen, windowed, curved monitor etc. you'll always get the best cozy experience. 🫰
[/list]

Thank you all for being so supportive of this journey and being a part of it all. Tavern Talk is a game that is surrounded by a loving community and we can feel that every day.

Those changes will take some time, but we wanted to let you know in advance, to give you an example for the foreseeable future and making sure that you know, that your voices are heard. ✨

Thank you again and safe travels,
Tommy

notes.title: WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Ocean Day!   

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale [b]starts today and runs until 15th June, 10am PDT 2024[/b]!
With every game you buy and that is part of the event, a certain percentage of the profit goes to WDC to support their conservation work.

[h2]Who is WDC?[/h2]

WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.
Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic creatures.

Entanglement in fishing gear, or ‘bycatch’ as it’s known, is the biggest threat whales and dolphins face. Many hundreds of thousands die in nets or get tangled up in fishing gear every year. As air-breathing mammals like us, when they get trapped in a net, panic can take over and they can sustain terrible injuries before either escaping, or suffocating. It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  

[h2]What WDC has been doing so far [/h2]

WDC have been working across the globe to protect whales, dolphins and porpoises from dying in fishing gear: 

[list]
[*] They’re collaborating with creel fishers in Scotland to trial new types of fishing gear to reduce entanglements of humpback and minke whales. 
[*] They’re working with colleagues and partner organisations in the Central Baltic Sea to develop a recovery plan for a critically endangered group of Baltic harbour porpoises. 
[*] On the west coast of the United States, critically endangered North Atlantic right whales are facing extinction. Entanglement is a massive threat to their survival, and WDC have been working with fishers to trial alternative gear types. 
[*] In Hong Kong WDC have been supporting local community efforts and working with fishers to save the remaining 200 Indo-Pacific finless porpoises from extinction due to bycatch.   
[/list]

These projects are saving lives, and they are powered by inspiring people working together for the ocean. 

[h2]How your support will help this year[/h2]

By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue these vital conservation projects across the globe, as well as enable WDC’s team to embark on new efforts to bring further protections for whales and dolphins, like the Sri Lankan gillnet fisheries project: 

[list]
[*] Sri Lanka is home to many species of whales, dolphins and porpoises as well as a myriad of other sensitive marine species like sea turtles that are vulnerable to entanglement in gillnets – these are nets that hang in the water like a wall. With funding, WDC hopes to collaborate with Sri Lankan artisanal tuna fisheries that use gillnets to trial new gear types and reduce the impact their fishing has on marine life, while still enabling them to earn their living. 
[/list]

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused
.

notes.title: The Wayfarer's Inn got a renovation! 🛠️
notes.content:
[h1][b]📰 The general news 📰[/b][/h1]

While the game is currently running circles in internal QA we are waiting for the last bits and pieces to fly in from the collaboration partners so those dialogs can find their way into editing and translations real soon. 

[h1][b]Approaching content completion ✍️[/b][/h1]

Everything is coming together now and it looks like we are going to have a content-complete version of the game by the end of the month, missing mainly localized content (because ~150.000 words are a lot to translate). That version will then go into external QA for an additional pair of uncompromised eyes to find the bugs we're incapable of seeing with our tunnel vision. 👀

[h1][b]Pushing audio 🎶[/b][/h1]

In the meantime our audio team is making a massive push to bring in music and sound effects with a special focus on the extraordinary parts of the game we managed to finance thanks to your generous support. Stay excited! We will reveal more about these in future updates when the time is right 🤐

[h1][b]👁️ A closer look... 👁️[/b][/h1]

Now that we have the general progress covered, let's take a closer look at some juicy details: Today we'd love to take a deep dive into what was made possible thanks to your extraordinary support on Kickstarter and after! 

Of course, we won't spoil anything regarding the Story of Tavern Talk or some special pledges that will be included in the game like the Wanted Posters, Trinkets, or Andu Animations! 👀 So don't worry as you continue reading. 

Everything is coming along really well and looking great so far! And having you all be a part of the game is just fantastic. 🥰

Check out these features that have found their way into the game and will contribute to a very special experience:

[h1][b]🎲 Bringing more TTRPG to the table 🎲[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/f3cd5c561b9f72b0ae0a3eddf815a0cd6cc191ec.png[/img]

[b]The new Tavern Talk title screen[/b]!
We have a new title screen! 🤩 Of course, this is still subject to change, but making our title screen a Dungeon Master screen seemed like the perfect match! And now the team needs one in real life 😭, but that's a discussion to have some other time! 😌
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/ef0082d72abe9750b7f805ccb3fdbd75994468b7.png[/img]

[b]The new Tavern Talk menu screen![/b]

When opening the title screen, we get to the new menu screen! 🙀 Right now there are some placeholders, like the "Gentle Troll"-Troll (or is it an easter egg, who knows 🥚), but those will be replaced with Wanted Posters - yay! 🤠

And yes, every time you return to the game, there will be another randomly selected Wanted Poster waiting for you. One of them will be your own if you pledged for the Infamous Hero tier. Eventually, you'll be able to see them all on the in-game gallery screen. 🖼️

[h1][b]📏 Font size & speed 📏[/b][/h1]

Let's talk about the new settings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/67caf024ea9caa196e6c6ae7ec319c2183a2282b.png[/img]

Thanks to some amazing feedback we've received on the demo and in our Discord, we worked away on the font size of the dialog bubbles within the game! As you can see you can now adjust the font size and have a text example show off the change right beneath it. ⬇️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/6edfe6ee0e3a7c2dfbdbcc69f0d8f3744d8423cc.png[/img]

That way you won't bump into any surprises when returning to the game. Also, you can now choose to turn the text animation off, making the text appear instantaneously. 

[b]Speaking of things appearing fast, let's talk about text speed! ⛷️
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/91773bae4d60f885d1354d8b00b48b9efd90fe2c.png[/img]

A slider lets you gradually adjust text speed adjusting it perfectly to your personal reading speed! That way you can customize how fast your Patrons talk to you. So, if you'd like to tune down speed to up the cozy feel ... you're welcome! Or if you want to make it faster, because you are on your 111th playthrough, we've got you covered! 👍

But the settings and screens are not the only things that have changed. 👀

[h1][b]🛠️ Renovation time! 🛠️[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/708b133341f961269fa598f7cda8fbc80dd7dd0d.png[/img]

[b]The new Tavern background[/b]
Can you spot the differences? And more importantly, can you spot all the easter eggs we have already hidden in this screenshot? 👁️

With the new Trinkets being added to the game and the cool in-game camera zooms (remember that stretch goal from the campaign?), some things had to be rearranged in the Tavern. 🧹

But we also added and polished more details in the background, to give the Wayfarer's Inn a more lifed-in feel! You know what they say, the cozier, the better! 💕

What do you think of the new additions so far? Leave us a comment here or in our Discord. 💜 

Next time we will show you some of the fancy tarot cards currently in the making and even more wonderful additions to the game! Stay tuned for our Tavern Spotlight! 🔍

Cheers,
Tommy

notes.title: Upcoming features and updates for Tavern Talk 01/04/2024
notes.content:
We have some amazing updates for you! These improvements will be part of the final game and will help in the long run to give you the best version of Tavern Talk.

- [b]Andu is no longer in the game.[/b] 💨

We found out that Andu took a lot of the overall processing power of the game and to combat that we decided to remove them from the game entirely. There is still Andu's bucket, so just use your imagination. Theater of the Mind is an important part of D&D!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/b5eb8ada10afca810730b52a266b50bb8a416faf.png[/img]

- [b]We made the text smaller.[/b] 🤏

The story of Tavern Talk got so immense that we decided to shrink the text, so we can give you more on each text bubble! It's harder to read, but we are sure you have glasses at home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/cf312a9afa2f0ecd063af12eef754f0da2187801.jpg[/img]

- [b]The text speed is now even slower[/b] 🦥

You heard that right. To give you the chance to read everything word by word and not to miss anything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/4c557cffbd98cbec41583bdf30f743e77d9b2a4d.jpg[/img]

- [b]Each in-game day will be a DLC![/b] 🫰

This way the Tavern fun will last longer. Yeah, some days are only 10-20 minutes long, but if we release every week, you don't have to wait so long to get the full experience in the end. And in only 40 Weeks (each day costing about 2€) you will have the full story. It is just like waiting for your favorite anime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/736dae1fb524e6a2487dafc34504facc49143ecf.jpg[/img]

- [b]You can play Tavern Talk exactly once![/b] 💯

We always said it is Coffee Talk meets D&D and to focus more on the D&D aspect of the game, we decided that you can play Tavern Talk exactly once. After you finish the game, your file will be corrupted preventing you from playing it again. Making all your decisions permanent, just like in D&D! This feature links directly to your Steam Account. Deleting and re-installing won't do the trick and would be cheating anyway. If you want to try it again, to get a different outcome, you can always make a new Steam Account and buy it again, I guess. Tavern Talk is now officially the Dark Souls of Visual Novel Games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/a963df2d7822d00f0486a82e18afd078fe23f74c.jpg[/img]

- [b]Controller Input will be a thing[/b] 🎮

Some people like it more than playing with a mouse and keyboard.

- [b]Major performance improvement[/b] 💪

Just like Andu, we noticed that one flying particle in the Tavern was causing the game to crash. We removed it. You are welcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/99ca7370d25030579641fbd8db88cf32be3cfe58.jpg[/img]

I hope you enjoyed this glimpse into the future of gaming! Have a great April (April started just now, right? Sorry, I am a silly fool) and see you soon. 💜

notes.title: We have two new characters to announce! 🥰
notes.content:
We still have a lot of time until we can finally enjoy the full game of Tavern Talk, but until then we want to keep you u[b]pdated on any new characters[/b]!

This time we have two very different personalities, but we hope you are going to like them nonetheless. [b]Please let us know your thoughts in the comments![/b]

Let's start with [b]Clay Moor![/b]

Despite being a barbarian, Clay Moor (he/him), a gentle half-giant, half-earth echo often prefers the non-violent route – though he has no trouble defending himself in a fight. With his Druid multiclass he is a close friend to any and all animals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/8ab2e4f4b3f3c0ee71644ad1e60facf8a1a0bb2b.png[/img]

And then there is[b] Grace Hex[/b]!

Grace Hex (she/her) is a half-elven wizard and the younger sister of the great wizard Hexagon Hex. She is currently working on her wizard Ph.D. Thesis and is ready to leave her mark on this world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/9080001fa42d3b06c12ec609160f365f84cbf902.png[/img]

If you want to have an early sneak peek of upcoming characters, feel free to join our discord! 
[url=https://discord.gg/dcRbYHWHMs]https://discord.gg/dcRbYHWHMs[/url]

And because the new year is just around the corner (the year of Tavern Talk), everybody from the Team wanted to say something important: [b]THANK YOU ALL SO MUCH![/b]

Your constant support and love for this game means the world to us and it keeps us going! We can't wait to show you even more in the next year!

Until then, stay safe and see you soon,
Tommy

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/b488cc12c4e0b24e3a5bd2d95f251589eaea2df9.png[/img]

notes.title: Can we still pet Andu in the final game?... Maybe 👀
notes.content:
One of our last Kickstarter stretch goals was the[b] in-game pet Andu feature[/b], sadly we did not make it so far. But since the Kickstarter ended we thought about how we could make it work in any other way and we came up with a solution! A solution where every one of you can easily help out and it would help Tavern Talk immensely! ❤️‍🔥

We are returning the Social Media Stretch Goals and letting them continue until May 2024! That way we would not only unlock this [b]new cute feature in our game[/b], if everybody bands together, but also grab the [b]Gamescom exclusive Demo[/b] along the way. We even included new ways to get some stamps to make it easier to [b]reach the Pet Andu Goal[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/184e961ff1bd1c20819533ade8ac23fe873f9da0.png[/img]

At first glance, [b]it seems like a lot[/b], but let me break it down for you and you will see that we can make it in no time! 

First off, the Steam Wishlists! They are really important for the visibility of our game and can help us in the long run. Right now we have [b]over 51k Wishlists[/b] on Steam. Thanks to the help of content creators and everybody who shared our game, we [b]flew right by our initial goal of 35k[/b]! If we [b]keep sharing the link[/b], we will be at 60k in no time: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076140/Tavern_Talk/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076140/Tavern_Talk/[/url]

We just managed to hit[b] 1.710 Discord Members[/b] and we already achieved the next Stamps there. Making it to [b]2.000 Discord Members[/b] shouldn't be a hassle! So if you [b]want to invite people[/b], there you go: [url=https://discord.gg/dcRbYHWHMs]https://discord.gg/dcRbYHWHMs[/url]

We just crossed [b]290 followers on Bluesky[/b] (an alternative to Twitter)! If you still need an [b]invite code to Bluesky[/b], don't worry there are a lot of people in our Discord willing to give you one. That way we will reach the [b]500 followers[/b] easily: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/taverntalkgame.bsky.social]https://bsky.app/profile/taverntalkgame.bsky.social[/url]

Our [b]Announcement Trailer[/b] for Tavern Talk is a big one! After the Kickstarter ended we made it to [b]over 981 likes[/b]! If everybody who follows Tavern Talk would leave a like (or even a second one with a second account 💡) we would already be at [b]2.000 likes[/b] without a problem: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zyuQO3a-JHI]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zyuQO3a-JHI[/url]

Last but not least, [b]Steam Followers[/b]. [b]Next to the wishlist button[/b] on Steam is the [b]follow button[/b]! Just hit that and we get some easy free stamps. As of now, we have [b]2.638 followers[/b] making it to the [b]second stamps of 2.800 followers[/b] should be as easy as drink mixing in the Wayfarer's Inn! So don't forget to leave a follow. 💜

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588827/fc2850237607b11a6c92183dfa01108a59ba4b08.png[/img]

[b]Together we can make it!!![/b]

notes.title: Monster Roadtrip meets Tavern Talk
notes.content:
We have some amazing news for all of you and you don't wanna miss that! 

We are ready to announce our first collaboration for Tavern Talk. It fits the spooky season perfectly, because there is probably no better game we could do a cross-over with than [b]Monster Roadtrip from Beautiful Glitch[/b]!

Not only did they support us in a lovely way with this quote in our "[b]A Word From Our Friends[/b]" section in our campaign body: [i]"A funny visual novel with lovely art, charming characters and magic drinks? Something tells us Tavern Talk is right up our alley!" [/i]

They also agreed to us doing a fun bit in Tavern Talk, where [b]Scott and Polly[/b] pay a visit to the Wayfarer's Inn: On their road trip they accidentally travel through the Primordial Vortex and end up in our beloved tavern. 

What stories will they tell? Well, there is only one way to find out - by playing Tavern Talk, of course. 

Don't worry, this [b]won't be a DLC[/b] but free for all to enjoy. It is a testimony of [b]Indie Gaming love[/b], so to speak.

But who is this mysterious character in the middle? It's [b]Baya, the swamp witch[/b]! 
A new character you will get to know better in the upcoming days! Maybe she'll befriend Scott and Polly and they can go on a road trip together? It would be a monstrous Party!
